messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired — HEARTBEAT spike for runtime-canary-us-west-2. Metric: host.heartbeat.count. Trigger: 3m window > 99thpct. Severity: P3. Pager: @maria. Incident link: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/INC-33245

maria: Acked. I'm on call, taking this. Starting quick checks (dashboards + canary logs).

sam: Noted. I ran a quick glance at prod traces and error rates — nothing abnormal across prod. APDEX/5xx both flat. No customer-facing incidents so far.

lee: Running canary metric query now:
```
sum(rate(host_heartbeat_count[1m])) by (host)
```
Result (top hosts):
- canary-01: 8/s
- canary-02: 6/s
- canary-03: 121/s  <-- spike here
Looks like a ~30s burst on canary-03, maybe a noisy probe or a probe storm.

maria: Thanks lee. Can you tail the canary-03 logs for that window? grep for "heartbeat" and any retry loops.

lee: tailing logs...
```
2026-02-14T21:05:12Z canary-03 heartbeat sent id=ae3f
2026-02-14T21:05:13Z canary-03 heartbeat sent id=ae40
2026-02-14T21:05:13Z canary-03 heartbeat retry count=1
2026-02-14T21:05:14Z canary-03 heartbeat sent id=ae41
2026-02-14T21:05:40Z canary-03 heartbeat sent id=ae6f
```
Looks like a small retry storm, maybe a network hiccup causing retries to pile for ~25-30s. No exceptions.

maria: Good catch. That matches the metric spike. No user traffic impacted. I'll keep this open for 5m then close if it quiets. Setting a short suppression so duplicate PD pages don't flap.

incident-bot: Auto-resolve action: PagerDuty incident INC-33245 auto-resolved at 3324500060. Reason: metric returned below threshold for 2 consecutive evaluation windows. No escalation. (auto-silence window applied: 120s)

sam: Confirming post-spike: traces show normal request latencies, no error-rate bump. Customer impact: none.

jordan: Can someone file a quick follow-up ticket to tune the canary retry logic and consider a 10s debounce on host_heartbeat_count to avoid short bursts? I can action later.

maria: I'll create the follow-up ticket and assign to infra. Tentative labels: alert-tuning, canary, follow-up. Link to ticket once created.

sam: Suggestion for follow-up: consider adding host-level smoothing or increase evaluation window to 60s for this alert so 30s retry storms don't page.

maria: Agreed. Also adding note: check if canary-03 had a transient network hiccup in the region (cloud provider network event feed).

lee: will correlate with provider events. so far nothing flagged in provider status for that minute.

maria: Handing off: I'm off-call at 22:00; @lee please own follow-up tomorrow morning. If anything re-fires immediately, escalate to P2 per the runbook. :thumbsup:

jordan: Thanks — I'll watch the follow-up ticket and help with alert wording.

incident-bot: Thread closed (auto-resolve). Metrics will continue to be monitored.

maria: closing here. No customer impact. Follow-up ticket: https://git.example.com/redwood/issues/4567 (created)

sam: Thanks all.

lee: lgtm, will pick this up in AM.
